subject_description: a TV home shopping host shown from the chest up, black suit, white shirt, dark red tie, white made-up face, large black eyes, tiny clip-on microphone on the lapel
initial_pose: body and head turned three quarters to the right, black eyes looking at the camera, both hands raised in front of the chest with the fingertips touching, closed-lip smile
description: talks to the camera like a thrilled, excited salesman, faster and louder: the mouth opens and closes over and over as if speaking, quickly; the eyebrows rise, the head bobs eagerly; the hands part, one hand clenches into a fist and pumps down hard in front of the chest in rhythm with the words; then settles back into the starting pose The shoulders stay almost still and never move sideways; the whole body and both hands stay inside the frame.
